top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks credited to Katori and Ye rest on a checkable mechanism (magic-wavelength cancellation of the lattice light shift with Lamb-Dicke confinement of many atoms), a measured result near 1e-18 reproduced with Sr, Yb and Hg in several laboratories, and a two-name credit that fits the three-laureate limit without arbitrary exclusions. The novelty margin over the 2005 and 2012 prizes and the omission of other lattice-clock groups are real but are answered by the distinct ensemble mechanism, and the citation is scoped to the neutral-atom lattice scheme. This is judged better than awarding nothing.
